enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable. Loses 1 life after each complete enemy round: survive 15 rounds. Creates increasingly large insect waves. Later waves emerge closer: the final four spawning waves attempt 4, 6, 8 and 10 Burrowers in columns 1–4, 1–3, 1–2 and 1. Each acts starting next round. The last round only commands survivors. All insects vanish at 0. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Area attacks thin the swarm; filling spaces denies ordinary spawns. Save defenses for insects already behind your front line.
